pairs: Et factum est in una dierum,
on one of the days when he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Gospel,
and they spoke to him, saying:
Dic nobis in qua potestate hæc facis?
“Tell us, by what authority do you do these things?
aut quis est qui dedit tibi hanc potestatem?
Or, who is it that has given you this authority?”
Interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum.
“I will also question you about one word.
The baptism of John, was it from heaven,
So they discussed it among themselves,
‘Then why did you not believe him?’
the whole people will stone us.
certi sunt enim Joannem prophetam esse.
For they are certain that John was a prophet.”
Et responderunt se nescire unde esset.
And so they responded that they did not know where it was from.
Neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate hæc facio.
“Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
Cœpit autem dicere ad plebem parabolam hanc:
Then he began to tell the people this parable:
and he loaned it to settlers,
et ipse peregre fuit multis temporibus.
and he was on a sojourn for a long time.
Et in tempore misit ad cultores servum,
And in due time, he sent a servant to the farmers,
ut de fructu vineæ darent illi.
so that they would give to him from the fruit of the vineyard.
And they beat him and drove him away, empty-handed.
And he continued to send another servant.
But beating him and treating him with contempt,
And he continued to send a third.
Then the lord of the vineyard said:
I will send my beloved son.
Perhaps when they have seen him,
And when the settlers had seen him,
so that the inheritance will be ours.’
And forcing him outside of the vineyard,
Quid ergo faciet illis dominus vineæ?
What, then, will the lord of the vineyard do to them?”
and he will give the vineyard to others.”
Then, gazing at them, he said:
ait: Quid est ergo hoc quod scriptum est:
“Then what does this mean, which is written:
‘The stone which the builders have rejected,
hic factus est in caput anguli?
the same has become the head of the corner?’
Omnis qui ceciderit super illum lapidem, conquassabitur:
Everyone who falls on that stone will be shattered.
super quem autem ceciderit, comminuet illum.
And anyone upon whom it falls will be crushed.”
Et quærebant principes sacerdotum et scribæ mittere in illum manus illa hora,
And the leaders of the priests, and the scribes, were seeking to lay hands on him in that same hour,
cognoverunt enim quod ad ipsos dixerit similitudinem hanc.
For they realized that he had spoken this parable about them.
And being attentive, they sent traitors,
who would pretend that they were just,
ut caperent eum in sermone, ut traderent illum principatui, et potestati præsidis.
so that they might catch him in his words and then hand him over to the power and authority of the procurator.
scimus quia recte dicis et doces:
we know that you speak and teach correctly,
and that you do not consider anyone’s status,
sed viam Dei in veritate doces.
but you teach the way of God in truth.
Is it lawful for us to pay the tribute to Caesar,
Whose image and inscription does it have?”
And so, he said to them:
“Then repay the things that are Caesar’s,
and the things that are God’s,
Et non potuerunt verbum ejus reprehendere coram plebe:
And they were not able to contradict his word before the people.
And being amazed at his answer,
Accesserunt autem quidam sadducæorum, qui negant esse resurrectionem,
Now some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection,
approached him. And they questioned him,
Si frater alicujus mortuus fuerit habens uxorem,
If any man’s brother will have died, having a wife,
and if he does not have any children,
ut accipiat eam frater ejus uxorem,
then his brother should take her as his wife,
and he should raise up offspring for his brother.
And so there were seven brothers.
And the first took a wife,
And the next one married her,
et ipse mortuus est sine filio.
and he also died without a son.
and none of them left behind any offspring,
For certainly all seven had her as a wife.”
“The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
illi vero qui digni habebuntur sæculo illo,
Yet truly, those who shall be held worthy of that age,
and of the resurrection from the dead,
will neither be married, nor take wives.
For they can no longer die.
For they are equal to the Angels,
and they are children of God,
since they are children of the resurrection.
For in truth, the dead do rise again,
as Moses also showed beside the bush,
And so he is not the God of the dead,
For all are alive to him.”
Then some of the scribes, in response,
Et amplius non audebant eum quidquam interrogare.
And they no longer dared to question him about anything.
Quomodo dicunt Christum filium esse David?
“How can they say that the Christ is the son of David?
et ipse David dicit in libro Psalmorum:
Even David himself says, in the book of Psalms:
donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
until I set your enemies as your footstool.’
So how can he be his son?”
Now in the hearing of all the people,
who choose to walk in long robes,
and who love greetings in the marketplace,
and the first chairs in the synagogues,
and the first places at table during feasts,
who devour the houses of widows,
These will receive the greater damnation.”
